column1: # The Open5GS fork's allow-list (P1 N17; ADR 0010 point 3): a row FAIL on Open5GS that an entry here
# names is scored ALLOWED. Columns: allow id, row id, reason, clause, Open5GS reference (fork 741c29d8d).
# O5GS-1 is decision D3 (2026-10-15): the fork has no SMS over NAS, its AMF never sets "SMS over NAS allowed";
# ksim-p1.sms-not-allowed checks the UE honours that and is not allowed here.
# O5GS-2 (N17, run open5gs-20261015T105150Z): the fork's AMF keeps UE contexts in amfd's memory only and
# drops SCTP when it stops, with no draining. After a restart it answers a SERVICE REQUEST with #9, the UE
# (rightly, TS 24.501 5.6.1.5) releases its sessions and registers again from the SUCI with a new
# authentication. The kaluza-core rows assume an AMF that keeps them.
